instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.defect: AppleScript `keystroke` inside `tell (first process whose bundle identifier is ...)` is delivered to the FRONTMOST application, not to the process named in the tell block.
instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.reading: With iTerm2 frontmost, three `keystroke "z" using command down` sent inside a `tell` block addressed to Logic left the 편집 menu's first item unchanged at `리전 경계에 2개의 트랙 오토메이션 포인트 생성 실행 취소` and its second item at `실행 복귀할 수 없음`. Clicking menu item 1 of the same menu instead moved the label to `가져오기 실행 취소` and armed the redo entry.
instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.consequence: A reverify script that drives undo by keystroke can send Cmd-Z to whatever application happens to be frontmost, and then read an unchanged label as a finding about Logic.

instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.defect: The count of AXMenu elements in the application's AX tree does not measure whether a menu is OPEN.
instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.reading: After the parameter popup's menu was opened, the AXMenu total stayed at 49 across two failed Escape attempts AND after the menu was successfully closed. `count of (every menu bar item of menu bar 1 whose selected is true)` read 0 the whole time, while CGWindowList reported a Logic window at layer 101.
instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.consequence: CGWindowList layer > 0 is the on-screen truth; an AXMenu total is a statement about which menu objects exist.

instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.defect: Korean strings vended by Logic's AX interface are not uniformly normalized, so byte equality against a typed literal can report a difference between two identical texts.
instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.reading: The arrange window's AX title reads back as 무제 30 - 트랙 in which 무제 is four conjoining jamo (U+1106 U+116E U+110C U+1166) while 트랙, in the same string, is two precomposed syllables (U+D2B8 U+B799); the string is neither NFC nor NFD. Python byte equality against the NFC literal returned False and equality after NFC normalization returned True. The AXHelp values measured in this run are NFC.
instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.consequence: Offline comparisons in Python must normalize both sides when an AX reading meets a typed or canon literal. Comparisons of one AX reading against another must NOT normalize, because a normalization change between two states would be a real difference in the reading.
instrument_defects_found_while_measuring.does_not_apply_to_applescript: MEASURED: AppleScript's own comparison already normalizes. `osascript` evaluating `a contains b` and `a is b` with an NFD 무제 against an NFC 무제 returned true for both, so the AppleScript-side predicates in the reverify script need no normalization handling.
